data.one_liner: Explicitly reads environment variables into a dart file from a .env file.
data.what_it_does: Reads environment variables from a .env file or system environment variables at build time and generates a part file with typed constants. It supports obfuscation, optional fields, inheritance, and multiple environments.
use_when: You want compile-time safety and type checking for your environment variables.
You need to obfuscate sensitive keys or support multiple environments via .env files.
avoid_when: You need to read or change environment variables dynamically at runtime.
You cannot use code generation or build_runner in your workflow.
strengths: Flexible configuration via build.yaml, annotations, and CLI overrides
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation steps
Changes to hidden env files may not automatically trigger incremental rebuilds without build.yaml configuration
data.setup_notes: Add envied and dev:envied_generator and dev:build_runner, then run build_runner build.
